name: lingshu-monorepo
description: 灵枢 — 智能写作工作台 (Vue3 全栈)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n ws,web,admin -c cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev:ws" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:ws && npm run build:web && npm run build:admin
scripts.test:quick: python -c "from lingshu_api.main import app; print(f'OK: {sum(1 for r in app.routes if hasattr(r,\"methods\"))} routes')"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:python
scripts.lint:python: python -m ruff check lingshu_api novel_app tests
